The booking sites at Los Angeles hotels

68 sites, 17 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Hotels In America at 14, Booking.com at 13, Hotels.com at 12, Priceline at 12 and the hotel's own site at 12. Fewest sites: The Sojourn Los Angeles - Sherman Oaks (10); most: Sonesta Los Angeles Airport LAX (28, as were 2 others).

Hotels In America was lowest at Sheraton Gateway Los Angeles Hotel, The LINE LA and Hotel Indigo Los Angeles Downtown by IHG of its 14, and 5%+ above another site at 10. Booking.com was lowest at none of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 13. Hotels.com was lowest at none of its 12, and 5%+ above another site at 12.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 16: lowest at none, a median 26% above the lowest site. Nearest: Sheraton Gateway Los Angeles Hotel, $187 against $172 on Hotels In America. Farthest: The Wayfarer Downtown LA, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, $403 against $184 on Traveluro.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 7, Hotels In America at 3, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Hotelscombined.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, momondo.com at 1, Stayforlong.co.uk at 1 and 4 other sites at 4 between them (ties count for each). Taxes and fees in Los Angeles

They added a median of 16.2% ($43 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 12.4% at Lincoln Hotel Monterey Park/Los Angeles to 16.5% at Freehand Los Angeles; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 8 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Los Angeles, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Los Angeles hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 4 up, 3 down of 11; rose most Freehand Los Angeles, $147 to $200; fell most Hollywood Inn Suites Hotel, $144 to $58; another site lowest at 9.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 8 up, 4 down of 16; rose most Dream Hollywood, by Hyatt, $328 to $495; fell most Sheraton Gateway Los Angeles Hotel, $187 to $159; another site lowest at 12.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Los Angeles hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Los Angeles?

$303 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $145 at Lincoln Hotel Monterey Park/Los Angeles to $453 at InterContinental Los Angeles Downtown by IHG.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Los Angeles?

No: these prices come from a few Los Angeles dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 8 Los Angeles hotels rose more than 2%, 4 fell; Dream Hollywood, by Hyatt rose most, $328 to $495 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Los Angeles hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (7 hotels) and Hotels In America (3 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.
